title: Oklahoma 69, TCU 45: Gabriel Throws for 400 Yards in 2023 Finale
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. TCU on November 24, 2023?
answer: Oklahoma beat TCU 69-45 in Norman on Friday, November 24, 2023. Dillon Gabriel threw for 400 yards and three touchdowns, and Gavin Sawchuk ran for 130 yards and three scores.
summary: Oklahoma beat TCU 69-45 on Nov. 24, 2023: Dillon Gabriel threw for 400 yards, Gavin Sawchuk scored three times, and the Sooners piled up 607 yards.
body: The day after Thanksgiving in 2023, No. 13 Oklahoma closed its home schedule by beating TCU 69-45 at Gaylord Family-Oklahoma Memorial Stadium. It was the Sooners' last regular-season Big 12 game before the program left for the SEC.

Quarterback Dillon Gabriel did most of the damage through the air, finishing with 400 passing yards and three touchdowns. He also ran for a score before halftime, and he had thrown for 278 yards and two touchdowns by the break.

Running back Gavin Sawchuk added 130 rushing yards and three touchdowns, his fourth straight 100-yard game. Receiver Drake Stoops caught 12 passes for 125 yards and a score. In the fourth quarter, Billy Bowman returned an interception for a touchdown to push the lead to 69-38.

TCU did not go quietly. Quarterback Josh Hoover threw for 344 yards and four touchdowns, and the Horned Frogs finished with 520 yards. Even so, Oklahoma gained 607, and TCU's 45 points were the most any Sooners opponent had scored that season.

The win moved Oklahoma to 10-2 overall and 7-2 in the Big 12. The Sooners then had to wait on Saturday's Kansas State and Oklahoma State result to learn whether they would reach the conference title game.
